# Third-party notices

## PL_MPEG

The Mana MPEG-1 decoder uses bitstream parsing and VLC tables adapted from
Dominic Szablewski's [PL_MPEG](https://github.com/phoboslab/pl_mpeg), under the
MIT license. The CRI-specific numerical decoding path follows the original
game library. The copyright and full license are retained in
[CriManaMpeg1.LICENSE.txt](unity/Haruki3DMV/Assets/Haruki/MV/Runtime/Streaming/CriWare/CriManaMpeg1.LICENSE.txt).

## AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1

The preview post-processor contains a GLSL port of the EASU and RCAS algorithms
from AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.
